theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_stc_mollify_C1_fderiv_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Euclid n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∀ (v : Euclid n) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ ψ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ cthickening δ (tsupport φ) ∧ ∀ x, |fderiv ℝ ψ x v - fderiv ℝ φ x v| ≤ ε
